chunks: It is narrated from Ṣafwān al-Jammāl, who said:

I said to Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام: “My family is with me, and I intend hajj, so I tie my expenses at my waist.” He said: “Yes, for my father عليه السلام used to say: ‘Part of the strength of the traveller is safeguarding his expenses.’”

key_terms.أَهْلِي: my family accompanying me on the journey
key_terms.الْحَجَّ: the pilgrimage intended by the speaker
key_terms.حَقْوَيَّ: my waist, where the expenses are tied for safekeeping

ai.seo_question: Is it recommended to safeguard and secure one's travel expenses during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that a traveller should carefully protect his provisions and money during travel. In the context of hajj and family travel, safeguarding one’s expenses is presented as a sign of prudence and strength.
